explication: Nest is a TypeScript framework for building Node.js server applications. An incoming request is matched to controller routes, executed through framework-managed handlers and providers, then returned through an HTTP adapter; the repository also supports streaming responses, microservice transports, and WebSocket gateways. The map highlights those runtime responsibilities and dependency injection. The README documents the framework and adapter breadth; source-index references and excerpts support some internal links, while other runtime wiring is left dashed where its caller was not shown.
